title: SpiceXplorer verify record (verify_status.json)
description: Each circuit's DERIVED status rung as one `analog-db verify --json` run recorded it (plan §6 / D-13), reduced by `analog-db verify-status`. catalog.json reads it to publish `derived_status` beside the AUTHORED `status`; a rung is published only while the circuit's fingerprint is unchanged, the tiers that ran back it, and (for validated) every conform:* row passed. Recorded, NOT byte-drift-guarded; the catalog built from it is.

status.description: The rung verify.derive_status gave for this run.

tiers.description: Tiers with at least one pass or fail row for this circuit in the run (an all-skip tier did not run).

platform.description: Platform commit the harness ran on (12 hex digits, `-modified` when its checkout had uncommitted changes), or `unknown`.

fingerprint.description: verify_status.fingerprint at reduction time: the files under circuits/<id>/ except scoreboard/, layout entries, prose, figures and machine-local by-products, and, for a composite, those of each block its composition.yaml instantiates; any later change to those files voids the rung. scoreboard/ is read by T0's scoreboard:* rows but left out on purpose, because analog-db run --write appends to it.

conform.description: Present when Tier 4 ran: spec-bounded conform:*@<pdk> rows that passed, of all of them.
